ideas.pitch: A quantitative cyber risk quantification engine that ingests company asset metadata and simulates Monte Carlo probabilistic outage distributions to calculate predicted financial losses from ransomware attacks.
ideas.title: ActuaryRisk CyberMesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the Best Overall Project In Cybersecurity and Best UI/UX in CyberSecurity tracks by marrying actuarial science with cybersecurity loss estimation.

ideas.pitch: An insurance pricing and loan default predictive platform using LightGBM and explainable feature attributions to price micro-loans based on non-traditional alternative credit scoring data.
ideas.title: DefaultProphet
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns perfectly with the FinTech track and the actuarial mandate of predicting outcomes and quantifying risk under uncertainty.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics dashboard for educational institutions that calculates student dropout risk using historical grade sequences and behavioral telemetry, recommending timely interventions.
ideas.title: DropoutQuant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the EdTech track by focusing on statistical predictive modeling of student performance rather than a generic tutor chatbot.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge encrypted self-assessment vault where SMEs can securely input proprietary security audit logs without leaking raw data, automatically calculating an empirical cyber insurance premium.
ideas.title: CyberRisk UX Valuator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Competes strongly in the Best UI/UX in CyberSecurity track by blending high-polish user onboarding with cryptographic data privacy.

ideas.pitch: An exam preparation analytics app that models student probability of passing actuarial or high-stakes professional exams based on practice test telemetry and spaced repetition decay curves.
ideas.title: ActuarialEd Exam Risk Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organized by the London Institute of Actuarial Studies, the judging panel will appreciate a project directly tailored to actuarial exam preparedness and probabilistic skill mastery.
